:::{#exm-lempel-ziv-parsing}
#### The incremental parsing of a short message

<!-- no-figure: the example is a list of phrases -->

The code below follows @def-lempel-ziv-parsing for the message $\text{aabababbabbbab}$.
It prints the phrases in order,
then the number of symbols left over at the end.

```{r}
#| label: lempel-ziv-parsing
message_text <- "aabababbabbbab"
symbols <- strsplit(message_text, "")[[1]]
phrases <- character(0)
current <- ""
for (symbol in symbols) {
  candidate <- paste0(current, symbol)
  if (candidate %in% phrases) {
    current <- candidate
  } else {
    phrases <- c(phrases, candidate)
    current <- ""
  }
}
phrases
nchar(current)
```

The message has $`r nchar(message_text)`$ symbols,
and the parsing cuts it into $`r length(phrases)`$ phrases
with none left over.

:::
